title: A rectangle under a parabola · Set 3
statement:
A rectangle has its base on the $x$-axis and upper corners at $(\pm x,3([$a])^2-x^2)$. Give its maximum area.

[__________]{a}
hints: Multiply the full width $2x$ by the height.
Compare the positive critical point with the zero-area endpoints.
solution: $A=2x(3[$a]^2-x^2)$ has derivative $6([$a]^2-x^2)$. The maximum occurs at $x=[$a]$ and is $4([$a])^3$.

feedback.message: Compare the positive critical point with the zero-area endpoints.
